Type: industrial four-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes, small items on open shelf; bedroom
Style: industrial, rustic
Materials: rough-sawn pine with oak finish, black metal frame base, black bar pulls
Colors: warm honey wood, matte black
Shape: tall narrow case, open cubby above four drawers, long bar handles, raised on open black steel sled base, compact
Feel: warm, rugged, casual
Goes with: brick or white walls, black metal, leather; industrial or loft bedrooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Eastport Industrial Wood Dresser, 30"W, Oak Finish
product.description: This rustic planked pine chest of drawers with an oak veneer will be a perfect addition to your master suite or any bedroom. Four drawers of storage space plus an open shelf in a modern industrial design. Durable solid wood is built to last and sustainably sourced. 30"W x 17.7"D x 48.8"H Handcrafted from solid wood. Modern industrial design of natural pine to blend with modern and rustic styles Drawers feature wood runners and metal handles. No assembly needed. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
